annotations.title: Book a call with Growth Business Finance

description: Use this only when the user has chosen one of the slots from get_available_slots and asked to book it. It books a 30 minute Google Meet call with the broker at Growth Business Finance and sends a calendar invite to the email address given in the enquiry. Before calling: confirm the chosen date and time with the user and get their explicit go-ahead. If the slot has just been taken it returns fresh slots and books nothing. One call can be booked per enquiry; repeating the call does not create a second booking.

booking_token.description: The booking_token returned by submit_enquiry. Never ask the user for it.

slot_id.description: The slot_id of the slot the user chose, from get_available_slots.
